articles.title: Self-Improving Training & Thinking
articles.abstract: Large language models are classically trained in stages: pretraining on raw text followed by post-training for instruction following and reasoning. However, this separation creates a fundamental limitation: many desirable behaviors such as safety, factuality, overall generation quality, and reasoning ability are only added at a late stage, even though the patterns learned earlier strongly shape a model's capabilities. To tackle this issue, we introduce a new way to pretrain and mid-train models that incorporates these behaviors earlier. We utilize an existing strong, post-trained model to both rewrite data and to judge policy model rollouts, thus introducing thinking and reinforcement earlier in training. We further improve reasoning at all stages by introducing the concept of self-improving post-thinking: improving the model's reasoning and self-judging ability by reasoning after generation. In our experiments, we show these approaches can give strong gains across multiple axes.
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通常分阶段进行训练：首先在原始文本上进行预训练，然后进行指令遵循和推理的后训练。然而，这种分离存在一个根本性限制：许多理想行为，如安全性、事实性、整体生成质量和推理能力，仅在后期阶段才被添加，尽管早期学习的模式强烈塑造了模型的能力。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种新的预训练和中训练模型的方法，将这些行为更早地融入训练中。我们利用一个现有的强大预训练模型来重写数据，并评判策略模型的输出，从而在训练早期引入思考和强化。我们进一步通过引入自我改进的后思考概念，在所有阶段提升推理能力：通过生成后的推理来改进模型的推理和自我评判能力。在我们的实验中，我们展示了这些方法可以在多个维度上带来显著提升。

articles.title: Cold-Start Personalization via Bayesian Adaptive Questioning
articles.abstract: Cold-start personalization requires inferring preferences from minimal interaction when no user-specific historical data is available. The space of possible preferences is vast, yet users care about only a sparse subset and rarely articulate them upfront; combined with limited interaction budgets, this makes preference elicitation challenging. Our key insight is that preferences exhibit predictable structure across populations; e.g., users who want detailed explanations often also value worked examples. We propose CAPE (Cold-start Adaptive Preference Elicitation), which learns a structured world model of preference correlations offline from complete profiles, then performs training-free Bayesian inference online to select informative questions and predict complete preference profiles, including dimensions never asked about. Even simple belief model instantiations (e.g., linear regression) substantially outperform end-to-end RL. Across medical, mathematical, social, and commonsense reasoning, CAPE achieves 80.8% alignment with ground-truth user preferences versus 68.5% for RL, requires 2.5x to over 15x fewer interactions, and adapts its questions twice as often as RL. Our contribution is a principled decomposition of cold-start personalization that makes Bayesian preference elicitation practical at scale for LLM systems.
articles.titleCn: 基于贝叶斯自适应提问的冷启动个性化
articles.abstractCn: 冷启动个性化需要在缺乏用户特定历史数据时，从极少的交互中推断用户偏好。可能的偏好空间极为广阔，但用户只关心其中稀疏的子集，且很少一开始就明确表达；再加上有限的交互预算，这使得偏好获取变得极具挑战性。我们的核心洞察在于，偏好在不同人群中表现出可预测的结构；例如，希望获得详细解释的用户通常也重视实例分析。我们提出了CAPE（冷启动自适应偏好获取），该系统通过离线学习从完整用户画像中构建偏好相关性的结构化世界模型，然后在在线过程中进行无训练贝叶斯推理，以选择信息量大的问题并预测完整的偏好画像，包括从未被询问的维度。即使是简单的信念模型实例化（例如线性回归）也显著优于端到端的强化学习。在医学、数学、社交和常识推理领域，CAPE与真实用户偏好的符合度达到80.8%，而RL仅为68.5%，交互次数减少2.5倍至15倍以上，且其问题调整频率是RL的两倍。我们的贡献在于对冷启动个性化的原则性分解，使得贝叶斯偏好获取在LLM系统中大规模应用成为可能。

articles.title: Einstein World Models
articles.abstract: Does intelligence require the ability to reason about phenomena beyond direct experience? It is natural to suspect that some complex thought cannot be captured through language alone. However, of particular concern to this work, is whether visualising counterfactual events can complement language as a mechanism for complex thought. We ask whether LLMs can be trained to utilise such visualisation mechanisms, in a way that benefits their reasoning abilities. Motivated by this question, we propose Einstein World Models. EWMs are a blueprint for LLM-based reasoning systems that place visual-temporal rollouts inside the reasoning trace, allowing them to reason in ways that text alone may not support well. In an EWM, the LLM calls a world-module (not to be confused with a world model), to produce short rollouts of scenes under consideration. The returned rollout is treated not as the answer, but as an inspectable hypothesis that can support later reasoning. Einstein World Models extend the capability of LLMs for tool calling (such as web search or code execution), into the domain of visual thought experiments.
articles.abstractCn: 智慧是否需要能够推理直接经验之外的现象？人们自然地怀疑，某些复杂思维无法仅通过语言来捕捉。然而，本研究特别关注的是，可视化反事实事件是否可以作为复杂思维的机制，补充语言的作用。我们探讨是否可以训练大型语言模型（LLMs）利用这种可视化机制，从而提升其推理能力。基于这个问题，我们提出了爱因斯坦世界模型（EWM）。EWM是一种基于LLM的推理系统蓝图，它将视觉-时间展开置于推理轨迹之中，使其能够以纯文本可能无法充分支持的方式进行推理。在EWM中，LLM调用一个世界模块（注意，这里的世界模块并非指世界模型），以生成所考虑场景的短时展开。返回的展开被视为可检查的假设，而非答案，用以支持后续推理。爱因斯坦世界模型将LLMs在工具调用（如网络搜索或代码执行）方面的能力，扩展到了视觉思想实验的领域。

articles.title: Probing the Origins of Reasoning Performance: Representational Quality for Mathematical Problem-Solving in RL vs. SFT Fine-Tuned Models
articles.abstract: Large language models trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to reason step by step have been increasingly shown to outperform their supervised fine-tuned (SFT) counterparts on mathematical reasoning tasks. Yet the mechanistic basis for this improvement remains unclear. We therefore ask, what internal representational differences enable RL-trained reasoning language models to reason better? Our work presents two primary lines of evidence: First, layer-wise linear probes tend to predict answer correctness more accurately in RL-trained reasoning language models than in instruction-tuned models on synthetic math problems, although output length alone matches the DeepSeek-Math-RL probe on two templates. Second, mean ablation studies suggest that accuracy drop rises with layer depth in DeepSeek-Math-RL but not in DeepSeek-Math-Instruct. Finally, we analyse token-count variability across accuracy bins for RL-trained reasoning language models and instruction-tuned models to measure whether token counts vary more on harder problems. Token counts tend to vary more on lower-accuracy problems, although in DeepSeek-Math-Instruct only with truncated responses included. At high accuracy, we observe lower variability in DeepSeek-Math-RL than in DeepSeek-Math-Instruct, and we observe higher variability in Olmo-3-Think than in Olmo-3-Instruct.
articles.titleCn: 探究推理表现起源：RL与SFT微调模型在数学问题解决中的表征质量
articles.abstractCn: 使用强化学习（RL）进行逐步推理的大型语言模型在数学推理任务上越来越多地显示出优于其监督微调（SFT）对应模型的表现。然而，这种改进的机制基础仍然不明确。因此，我们提出一个问题：哪些内部表征差异使RL训练的推理语言模型能够更好地进行推理？我们的研究提供了两条主要证据：首先，层级线性探针在合成数学问题上对RL训练的推理语言模型预测答案正确性的准确性通常高于指令微调模型，尽管输出长度单独匹配DeepSeek-Math-RL探针在两个模板上。其次，平均消融研究表明，在DeepSeek-Math-RL中，准确率下降随着层级深度的增加而上升，但在DeepSeek-Math-Instruct中则没有。最后，我们分析了RL训练的推理语言模型和指令微调模型在准确率分箱中的token计数变化，以测量token计数是否在更难的问题上变化更大。token计数倾向于在低准确率问题上变化更大，尽管在DeepSeek-Math-Instruct中仅在包含截断响应时如此。在高准确率下，我们观察到DeepSeek-Math-RL的变异性低于DeepSeek-Math-Instruct，而Olmo-3-Think的变异性高于Olmo-3-Instruct。

articles.title: T-SANDHI: Tone Sandhi-aware Adaptive Network with Decoupled Hybrid Injection for Low-resource Taiwanese Hokkien Speech Recognition
articles.abstract: In Taiwanese Hokkien automatic speech recognition (ASR), prior studies often treat tone sandhi as a major challenge under the assumption that models fail to process implicit phonological variations. However, our experiments on Taiwanese Hokkien reveal that speech foundation models actually handle tone sandhi variations effectively, and the real performance bottleneck stems from a localized confusion between these variations and retained citation tones. To address this, we propose T-SANDHI to explicitly decouple surface acoustics from underlying lexical intent on top of a frozen Whisper backbone. Using a lexicon-guided multi-task learning structure driven by text-derived pseudo labels, our lightweight hybrid injection module integrates independent citation and sandhi phonetic streams via dynamic gating. Extensive evaluation on the TAT-MOE corpus and two blind test sets demonstrates that this explicit disentanglement effectively resolves tonal mapping confusion, outperforming baselines with strict parameter efficiency.
articles.titleCn: T-SANDHI：一种具有解耦混合注入的、感知声调变化的、适用于低资源台湾闽南语语音识别的自适应网络
articles.abstractCn: 在台湾闽南语自动语音识别（ASR）中，以往研究常将声调变调视为主要挑战，假设模型无法处理隐性的语音变化。然而，我们的台湾闽南语实验表明，语音基础模型实际上能有效处理声调变调变化，真正的性能瓶颈源于这些变化与保留的引语声调之间的局部混淆。为此，我们提出T-SANDHI，在冻结的Whisper主干网络之上，显式地将表面声学特征与底层词汇意图解耦。利用基于文本生成的伪标签驱动的词汇引导多任务学习结构，我们的轻量级混合注入模块通过动态门控机制整合独立的引语和变调语音流。在TAT-MOE语料库及两个盲测集上的大量评估表明，这种显式解耦能有效解决声调映射混淆问题，并在严格参数效率下优于基线模型。

articles.title: LARC: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections for Learning in Frozen Models
articles.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections (LARC) give a frozen model a compact numerical state that can learn from feedback. The map $h+BAh$ changes the hidden input to a pretrained mixer. An episode copies a learned initialization $\ρ$ into a private state $\Φ$, updates its factors when feedback arrives, and resets to the bound $\ρ$. We analyze the factor-space updates and trace this input-side policy carrier into Orbit, the post-training realization of Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture studied here. In Orbit's released default, the learned residual shapes predictions while memory adaptation changes the retained evidence.\n\nThe controlled studies use a rank-4 residual with 12,288 factor entries on frozen MiniCPM5-1B-SFT. Two feedback updates reduce expected query execution error by 24.65 and 36.65 percentage points relative to the respective trained reset states in a four-candidate development task with 16 parameter groups and three paired seeds. A direct support-loss rule reaches 0.78125\\% error. In repository-balanced chronological replay of public continuous-integration jobs, retaining updates raises half-Brier loss from 0.1274 to 0.1808. A follow-up intervention observes same-batch non-descent and inconsistent future benefit from shrinking steps. These comparisons measure when numerical state helps a later read and when the trained reference is more effective.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables. Technical report of MMLA. The authors contributed equally. Version 2 adds the Orbit realization, a factor-state counterexample, and updated public component access
articles.titleCn: LARC：冻结模型中的低秩自适应残差连接学习方法
articles.abstractCn:
低秩自适应残差连接（LARC）为冻结模型提供了一个紧凑的数值状态，使其能够从反馈中学习。映射 $h+BAh$ 将隐藏输入转换为预训练的混合器。一个周期将学习到的初始化 $\ρ$ 复制到私有状态 $\Φ$ 中，在收到反馈时更新其因子，并重置到界限 $\ρ$。我们分析了因子空间的更新，并将这种输入侧策略载体追踪到Orbit，即此处研究的记忆介导学习架构在训练后的实现。在Orbit的默认发布版本中，学习到的残差塑造预测，而记忆适应则改变保留的证据。

受控研究使用一个秩为4的残差，在冻结的MiniCPM5-1B-SFT上具有12,288个因子条目。在具有16个参数组和三个配对种子的四候选开发任务中，两次反馈更新分别将预期查询执行误差相对于相应的训练重置状态降低了24.65和36.65个百分点。直接支持损失规则达到0.78125%的误差。在仓库平衡的时序重放中，保留更新将半Brier损失从0.1274提高到0.1808。后续干预观察到相同批次非下降和缩减步长带来的不一致未来收益。这些比较衡量了数值状态何时有助于后续读取，以及训练参考何时更有效。

articles.title: Integrate the Reward, Don't Sample It: Window Likelihood for Interruptions and Backchannels in Full-Duplex Speech Models
articles.abstract: When a user talks over a full-duplex dialogue model, it must decide whether the user is interrupting (stop) or backchannelling (carry on). Post-training can improve this discrimination or change how readily it stops. In our GRPO runs the second dominates: no configuration lowers both error rates on more than one model, and two released checkpoints discriminate no better than their bases. We trace this partly to how the reward is estimated. The probability of stopping inside a short window is a known function of a few stop probabilities the policy emits, yet GRPO estimates it by sampling. A group of rollouts that all agree gives no gradient, even when all fail; the push on the stop threshold is strongest where the model is unsure, whichever outcome is right; and whole-rollout credit reaches decisions the reward never judges. Confining the credit to the window removes only that leakage. Window likelihood (WL) samples the words but integrates over the stop decisions, so the probability of the correct outcome is computed exactly and its logarithm maximised. On HumDial-FDBench, across four open models, WL gives the best F1 and lowers both error rates by more than their confidence intervals, without talking into silence.
articles.titleCn: 整合奖励，而非采样：全双工语音模型中干扰和反馈的窗口似然
articles.abstractCn: 当用户与全双工对话模型交互时，模型必须判断用户是在中断（停止）还是在进行回传（继续）。训练后微调可以改进这种区分能力或改变其停止的倾向性。在我们的GRPO运行中，第二种情况占主导地位：没有配置能同时降低超过一个模型的错误率，且已发布的两个检查点与它们的基准模型相比并无更好的区分能力。我们将此部分归因于奖励估计的方式。在短窗口内停止的概率是政策发出的几个停止概率的已知函数，但GRPO通过采样来估计它。一组所有结果都一致的运行不会产生梯度，即使所有结果都失败；对停止阈值的推动最强是在模型不确定的情况下，无论哪种结果是正确的；整个运行的信用会影响到奖励从未评判的决策。将信用限制在窗口内只能消除那种泄漏。窗口似然（WL）采样单词但积分覆盖停止决策，因此正确结果的概率被精确计算，并最大化其对数。在HumDial-FDBench上，针对四个开放模型，WL给出了最佳的F1值，并将两个错误率都降低了超过它们的置信区间，而不会导致模型沉默。

articles.title: FindLink: Learning to Assess Scientific Connections from Source-Grounded Premises
articles.abstract: Scientific discovery from the literature requires assessing connections among findings obtained under different study conditions. Source attribution makes individual findings traceable, but does not determine what they jointly support. We introduce GI-TraceBench, a benchmark of 10,282 questions in gastrointestinal oncology that unifies provenance question answering, knowledge discovery, and hypothesis evaluation through shared Paper, Claim, and Evidence Span records. We further propose FindLink, a two-stage framework for provenance-grounded scientific reasoning. Premise Grounding constructs source-bound premises with explicit study context and support status. Structured Reasoning organizes these premises into support plans that represent both supported relations and unresolved conditions, then generates evidence-conditioned answers using deterministic compiler feedback. The compiler verifies structural and source-binding consistency, but does not assess scientific entailment. On the 1,545-question fixed-evidence test set, FindLink improves the balanced family macro score from 67.95 to 87.25 over direct supervised fine-tuning of the same backbone. A retrained variant without Structured Reasoning achieves slightly higher premise-identifier F1, but substantially lower relation and evidence-sufficiency F1. These results indicate that scientific reasoning requires not only identifying grounded premises, but also assessing what connections those premises support.
articles.titleCn: FindLink：从源头锚定的前提中学习评估科学联系
articles.abstractCn: 从文献中进行科学发现需要评估在不同研究条件下获得的结果之间的联系。来源追溯使得单个发现可追溯，但并不能确定它们共同支持的内容。我们介绍了GI-TraceBench，这是一个包含10282个问题的胃肠道肿瘤学基准，它通过共享的论文、主张和证据跨度记录统一了来源问题回答、知识发现和假设评估。我们进一步提出了FindLink，这是一个基于来源的科学推理两阶段框架。前提构建构造具有明确研究背景和支撑状态的来源绑定前提。结构化推理将这些前提组织成支持计划，这些计划既表示支持关系，也表示未解决的问题条件，然后使用确定性编译器反馈生成证据条件答案。编译器验证结构和来源绑定的连贯性，但不评估科学蕴涵。在1545个固定证据测试集上，FindLink将相同骨干的直接监督微调的平衡家族宏观分数从67.95提高到87.25。一个不包含结构化推理的重训练变体在前提标识器F1上略有提高，但在关系和证据充分性F1上显著降低。这些结果表明，科学推理不仅需要识别绑定的前提，还需要评估这些前提支持的联系。

articles.title: CulturalCrosswords: A Multilingual Benchmark of Answer Constraints and Grid Completion
articles.abstract: When several answers fit a riddle, exact-match scoring can penalise a valid response. CulturalCrosswords tests how answer constraints affect large language models (LLMs) solving cultural riddles, whose solutions draw on knowledge specific to a community. We constructed 53 crosswords from crowdsourced riddles in 42 languages and evaluated 11 LLM configurations on five versions of each clue set: plain batches, batches with lengths, batches with lengths and partial-answer hints, and crosswords requesting an answer list or a completed grid. On 962 clues with alternative answers, lengths improve agreement with the reference by 22.8 percentage points, compared with 8.4 points when accepted alternatives also receive credit. Part of the gain therefore appears to come from selecting a required answer form. Crossword input increases the share of all crossings with compatible answers by 9.7 points; requiring a completed grid reveals large differences between models. The benchmark distinguishes agreement with a reference from the ability to produce answers that fit together and occupy the correct cells.
articles.titleCn: 文化填字游戏：多语言答案约束和网格补全基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 当多个答案符合谜题时，精确匹配评分可能会惩罚一个有效的回答。CulturalCrosswords测试了答案约束如何影响大型语言模型（LLMs）解决文化谜题，这些谜题的答案依赖于特定社群的知识。我们从42种语言的众包谜题中构建了53个字谜，并在每个线索集的五个版本上评估了11个LLM配置：普通批次、带长度的批次、带长度和部分答案提示的批次，以及要求答案列表或完成网格的字谜。在962个有多个答案的线索中，与参考答案的匹配度提高了22.8个百分点，而接受替代答案获得积分时，这一数字为8.4个百分点。因此，部分收益似乎来自选择所需的答案形式。字谜输入使兼容答案的交叉比例增加了9.7个百分点；要求完成网格揭示了模型之间的大差异。基准测试区分了与参考答案的匹配程度和生成能够相互匹配并占据正确单元格的答案的能力。

articles.title: Orthographic depth at two scales, with English also matched for lexicon size
articles.abstract: A reader can struggle to read in only one of their languages, and one proposed reason is how predictably spelling maps to sound. We measure that predictability as conditional entropy, the pronunciation uncertainty left once the spelling is seen, at two grain sizes (unit sizes): the alignment unit, an aligned spelling-sound chunk, and the syllable, bounded in the pronunciation. We analyse word lists in twelve alphabetic orthographies and report five in full, with English pronunciations from a dictionary and the rest from the synthesizer eSpeak-ng, length marks removed. Among the five, English has the most uncertainty and Finnish the least at both grains. Across all twelve, Portuguese and Danish exceed English per alignment unit, and German and Italian order differently by grain and transcription. These orders hold when English is transcribed by eSpeak-ng with u allowed to spell /j/ plus a vowel. Uncertainty per unit has no shared direction as units grow: it falls in Spanish and, less securely, German, is level in Finnish, depends on transcription in Italian and on the word list in English, and rises in Norwegian and Swedish. Summed uncertainty per word falls in all twelve, but that score is handed the pronunciation's boundaries and mixes context with in-sample memorisation, so it is no evidence of what a reader computes. An exact identity states when discarded spelling boundaries could reverse that fall. A uniform 20,000-word English sample holds 35% of the dictionary's syllable spellings and has syllable entropy 0.098 bits lower, so lexicons must be matched in size. In an exploratory check over eleven languages, syllable-scale entropy tracked first-year reading accuracy (rho = -0.74, falling to -0.25 if English is given the lowest entropy instead), without separating the syllable scale from the alignment unit. These estimates describe sampled writing systems, not readers.
articles.comment: 38 pages, 5 figures. Spelling-to-sound entropy as a measure of orthographic depth for cross-language reading research; exploratory check against Grade 1 reading accuracy in Section 3.5. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/A9T3C
articles.titleCn: 在两个尺度上进行正交深度，同时英语也按词汇量进行了匹配
articles.abstractCn: 读者可能只在一个语言中阅读时感到困难，而一个提出的原因是拼写与发音的映射规律性。我们将这种规律性测量为条件熵，即在看到拼写后剩余的发音不确定性，在两种粒度（单位大小）下进行测量：对齐单元，即对齐的拼写-发音块，以及音节，发音的边界。我们分析了十二种字母正字法的词汇表，并完整报告了五种，英语发音来自词典，其余来自合成器eSpeak-ng，移除了长度标记。在这五种中，英语的不确定性最高，芬兰语最低，在两种粒度下都是如此。在所有十二种中，葡萄牙语和丹麦语每对齐单元的不确定性超过英语，而德语和意大利语按粒度和转写方式呈现不同的顺序。当英语由eSpeak-ng转写，允许用u拼写/j/加元音时，这些顺序仍然成立。单位的不确定性随着单位增长没有共同的方向：它在西班牙语中下降，在德语中不太确定地下降，在芬兰语中保持不变，在意大利语中取决于转写，在英语中取决于词汇表，在挪威语和瑞典语中上升。每个单词的总不确定性在所有十二种中下降，但这个分数受到发音边界的限制，并与样本内记忆混合，因此它不是读者计算的证据。当丢弃拼写边界可能逆转这种下降时，会形成精确的同一性。一个统一的20,000词英语样本包含词典音节拼写的35%，其音节熵低0.098比特，因此词汇必须匹配大小。在一个对十一种语言的探索性检查中，音节尺度熵跟踪了第一年阅读准确率（rho = -0.74，如果英语被赋予最低熵，则下降到-0.25），而没有将音节尺度与对齐单元分开。这些估计描述了采样的书写系统，而不是读者。

articles.title: Free Lunch Uncertainty: Sequence-Level Rényi Entropy from Particle Decoding for Adaptive LLM Reasoning
articles.abstract: Quantifying uncertainty over an entire LLM completion is critical for selective prediction and adaptive compute. Zero-cost signals such as mean token entropy and log-probability are local to tokens or to one completion, and self-consistency needs many extra completions. We show that Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding for power sampling already estimates the normalizing constant of the power distribution, which gives the sequence-level R'enyi entropy (SRE) of the model's completion distribution at zero marginal cost, with a guarantee at every particle budget. A R'enyi chain rule extends this readout to a family of stepwise entropies of any order. We prove that orders above one are tied to the most likely token of each step, which explains why they track log-probability, while the order-1/2 member accumulates the log of per-step search effort. This member is the best zero-cost selective-prediction signal in 10 of 13 settings. On MATH500 its AUROC is 0.022 to 0.044 above log-probability with all four models and within length quartiles, and the same order is selected when each setting is held out. An 8-particle probe identifies the problems that benefit from more particles, and a two-pass policy matches 64-particle accuracy on MATH500 with 34.2% fewer particles over three seeds.
articles.titleCn: 免费午餐不确定性：基于粒子解码的序列级Rényi熵用于自适应LLM推理
articles.abstractCn: 在整个大语言模型（LLM）生成过程中量化不确定性对于选择性预测和自适应计算至关重要。零成本信号，如平均token熵和log概率，仅限于单个token或单个生成结果，而自洽性需要大量额外的生成结果。我们证明，用于功率采样的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）解码已经估计了功率分布的归一化常数，这能够在零边际成本下给出模型生成结果分布的序列级Rényi熵（SRE），并在每个粒子预算下提供保证。Rényi链规则将这一读数扩展到任意阶数的逐步熵族。我们证明，高于一阶的熵与每一步最可能的token相关联，这解释了为什么它们跟踪log概率，而一阶半成员则累积每一步搜索的log值。该成员在13种设置中的10种情况下是最佳的零成本选择性预测信号。在MATH500上，使用所有四种模型，该成员的AUROC比log概率高出0.022至0.044，且在长度四分位数范围内，当每种设置被排除时，仍选择相同阶数。一个8粒子探测识别出那些受益于更多粒子的场景，而两阶段策略在MATH500上以34.2%更少的粒子数，匹配了64粒子的准确性，跨越了三个种子。

articles.title: BioMem: Agentic Memory for Biomedical LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in biomedical applications, while agentic memory systems have emerged as a promising approach to preserving and utilizing information across tasks and interactions. However, a fundamental question remains: how effectively and reliably do these systems retain, retrieve, update, and utilize biomedical information? In this study, we systematically investigate agentic memory in the biomedical domain, focusing on task effectiveness, retrieval quality, information fidelity, and long-term robustness. We evaluate five memory approaches across four LLMs in three representative settings: biomedical knowledge reasoning, clinical prediction, and long-term conversational memory. Our analyses reveal how memory construction, evidence relevance, and conversational history shape downstream biomedical performance, highlighting the distinct challenges of retrieving relevant information, preserving its fidelity, and effectively utilizing it for reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce Hybrid Memory Retrieval and Utilization (HMRU), a training-free framework that jointly enhances evidence accessibility and task-aware utilization to improve biomedical reasoning and long-term conversational memory. HMRU achieves an average relative improvement of 8.6% across biomedical question-answering and conversational memory benchmarks, with additional gains in selected clinical prediction tasks. It further reduces conversational answer errors by 24.9% and closes 48.0% of the performance gap to full-context inference. Our findings provide a systematic characterization of biomedical agentic memory and practical insights into developing more effective and reliable memory-augmented LLM systems.
articles.titleCn: BioMem：生物医学大语言模型代理的自主记忆
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生物医学应用中展现出巨大潜力，而智能记忆系统已成为跨任务和交互中保存和利用信息的有前景的方法。然而，一个基本问题仍然存在：这些系统在保留、检索、更新和利用生物医学信息方面的有效性和可靠性如何？在本研究中，我们系统地研究了生物医学领域的智能记忆，重点关注任务有效性、检索质量、信息保真度和长期鲁棒性。我们在三个代表性场景——生物医学知识推理、临床预测和长期对话记忆——中，对四个LLMs的五种记忆方法进行了评估。我们的分析揭示了记忆构建、证据相关性和对话历史如何影响下游生物医学性能，突出了检索相关信息、保持其保真度以及有效利用其进行推理的独特挑战。基于这些发现，我们提出了混合记忆检索与利用（HMRU）框架，这是一个无需训练的框架，它联合增强了证据的可访问性和任务感知利用，以改进生物医学推理和长期对话记忆。HMRU在生物医学问答和对话记忆基准测试中实现了平均相对提升8.6%，并在选定的临床预测任务中取得了额外增益。它进一步将对话回答错误率降低了24.9%，并将性能差距缩小至全上下文推理的48.0%。我们的研究结果为生物医学智能记忆提供了系统性的表征，并为开发更有效和可靠的记忆增强LLM系统提供了实用见解。

articles.title: Off-target posterior mass: A training-free diagnostic for fine-tuning spoken language diarization probes
articles.abstract: Spoken Language Diarization (SLD) models provide frame-level language information of a speech recording. SLD modeling pipeline includes feature extraction from pre-trained speech models followed by clustering. Fine-tuning pre-trained speech models has shown performance gains for SLD with its magnitude being dataset dependent. Off-target Posterior Mass (OTPM), computed based on posterior language identification probabilities is proposed as a diagnostic metric to forecast performance gains from SLD fine-tuning. OTPM obtains positive correlation with probe gains, 0.56 on unseen synthetic bilingual data and 0.23 on real-world corpora. These results indicate promising potential of OTPM as a diagnostic metric for SLD.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to JASA Express Letters
articles.titleCn: 非目标后验质量：一种无需训练的精细调整语音语言说话人分割探针的诊断方法
articles.abstractCn: 语音语言分割（SLD）模型为语音录音提供逐帧的语言信息。SLD建模流程包括从预训练语音模型中提取特征，随后进行聚类。对预训练语音模型进行微调已被证明可以提高SLD的性能，其提升幅度取决于数据集。基于后验语言识别概率计算出的目标外后验质量（OTPM）被提出作为诊断指标，用于预测SLD微调带来的性能提升。OTPM与探测增益呈正相关，在未见过的人工双语数据上为0.56，在真实语料库上为0.23。这些结果表明OTPM作为SLD诊断指标的潜力巨大。

articles.title: Inherited Weights: Measuring the Tokenization Premium and the Sovereignty Cost of Language Models for the Global South
articles.abstract: Most language models deployed outside the United States and China are fine-tuned descendants of a small number of pretrained families. We argue that fine-tuning leaves the decisive properties of a model inherited from its base: vocabulary, knowledge, cultural alignment, memorized data and license. We contribute (i) an updated, reproducible measurement of the tokenization premium across 31 languages and 7 tokenizers released in 2023-2024, on 27 articles of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, with explicit correction for unknown-token collapse. Premiums reach 10x for Amharic in older tokenizers and remain at 6.8x in the newest commercial one; Indigenous South American languages pay between 1.6x and 2.7x under global tokenizers. A vocabulary built from Portuguese lowers the premium for 11 of 13 Latin-script Global South languages relative to every global tokenizer tested, by about 24% for Guarani and Quechua. (ii) An eight-test black-box sovereignty audit that a buyer can run without access to weights. (iii) A regime argument: under energy and liability constraints, accuracy per joule, calibration and selective risk should replace raw accuracy as design objectives, with metrics that abstention cannot inflate. We close with preliminary internal measurements from a proprietary architecture built around these objectives, reported with their limitations. Data and measurement code are included.
articles.comment: 6 pages, 2 tables. Data and measurement code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22899767
articles.titleCn: 继承权重：衡量全球南方语言模型的标记化溢价与主权成本
articles.abstractCn: 部署在美国和中国以外的语言模型大多是少数预训练家族的微调后裔。我们认为，微调保留了模型从其基础继承的决定性属性：词汇、知识、文化契合度、记忆数据及许可权。我们贡献了（i）一项更新且可复现的测量，针对2023-2024年发布的31种语言和7种分词器，在《世界人权宣言》27篇文章上的分词溢价，并明确修正了未知词折叠问题。在旧版分词器中，阿姆哈拉语的溢价高达10倍，而在最新商业分词器中仍维持在6.8倍；南美原住民语言在全球分词器下的溢价在1.6至2.7倍之间。基于葡萄牙语构建的词汇表使13种拉丁字母南半球语言的溢价相对于所有测试的分词器降低了约24%，其中瓜拉尼语和克丘亚语的溢价降幅尤为显著。（ii）一种八项测试的黑盒主权审计，买家无需访问权重即可执行。（iii）一种制度性论点：在能源和责任约束下，每焦耳的准确率、校准和选择性风险应取代原始准确率作为设计目标，并采用不会因弃权而虚高的指标。最后，我们报告了围绕这些目标构建的专有架构的初步内部测量结果，并说明了其局限性。数据与测量代码均已包含。

articles.title: Leveraging Psychophysical Attentional Distribution for Gaze-Augmented Reward Modeling
articles.abstract: Integrating human feedback into language models has gained increasing attention as a means to align model outputs with human preferences, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) serving as a prominent framework for preference-based alignment. Recent studies have incorporated eye-tracking (ET) data as an additional supervisory signal for reward model training, grounding reward learning in human reading behavior. Building on this approach, we extend prior fixation-centric models by leveraging established findings from cognitive psychology on human letter recognition. Specifically, we model visual attention as a spatially graded distribution centered on the current gaze location and incorporate this representation into reward model training. Our results show that the reward model trained with the proposed gaze distribution achieves higher preference prediction accuracy than a baseline model. Moreover, some results from our experiments are qualitatively consistent with established findings on human attention during reading, suggesting that they potentially capture cognitively meaningful aspects of human attention allocation.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026 Main Track)
articles.titleCn: 利用心理物理学注意力分布进行注视增强奖励建模
articles.abstractCn: 将人类反馈整合到语言模型中已成为一种使模型输出与人类偏好保持一致的重要手段，而人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）是偏好导向对齐的代表性框架。近期研究将眼动（ET）数据作为额外的监督信号用于奖励模型训练，将奖励学习建立在人类阅读行为的基础上。在此方法的基础上，我们通过利用认知心理学中关于人类字母识别的既有发现，扩展了先前的注视中心模型。具体而言，我们将视觉注意力建模为以当前注视位置为中心的空间梯度分布，并将这种表示纳入奖励模型训练中。我们的结果表明，使用所提出的注视分布训练的奖励模型在偏好预测准确率上高于基线模型。此外，我们实验中的一些结果与阅读时人类注意力的既有发现定性地相符，表明它们可能捕捉到了人类注意力分配的认知意义方面。

articles.title: Evaluating Compositional Generalization in Transformers: The Role of Composition Equivalence and Module Coverage
articles.abstract: Compositional generalization is an important form of out-of-distribution generalization, defined as the ability to train on some combinations of modules (e.g., functions such as sort, filter) and then generalize to unseen combinations. Despite substantial empirical work evaluating compositional generalization in transformers, findings have been inconsistent because evaluations were often conducted on a limited set of train-test splits, defined in an ad hoc manner. Through a systematic evaluation, we identify two key aspects of the train-test distribution that strongly affect performance: composition equivalence and module coverage. We show that the apparent performance of direct models (trained only on final outputs) results primarily from exploiting composition equivalences, meaning different sequences of modules that reduce to identical end-to-end functions. When benchmarks eliminate these equivalences, performance drops significantly, showing their inability to generalize to compositions of known modules that produce novel end-to-end functions. We further demonstrate that performance degrades monotonically as module coverage shifts increase (when modules appear in different contexts between train and test), affecting both direct and step-by-step models (trained on intermediate and final outputs). These findings have concrete implications for benchmark design: benchmarks that include compositional equivalences can lead to significant overestimation of the generalization abilities of direct models, and benchmarks that include both module coverage violations and compositional equivalences can exacerbate shortcut learning. As a case study, we demonstrate the role of compositional equivalence on the generalization performance of the pre-trained model Llama3-8B on the code-output prediction task in the coding benchmark LiveCodeBench.
articles.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
articles.titleCn: 评估Transformer中的组合泛化：组合等价和模块覆盖的作用
articles.abstractCn: 组合泛化是一种重要的分布外泛化形式，定义为在模块（例如sort、filter等函数）的某些组合上进行训练，然后泛化到未见过的组合的能力。尽管在Transformer模型中，组合泛化已经得到了大量的实证研究，但研究结果一直不一致，因为评估通常在有限且非系统定义的训练-测试分割集上进行。通过系统评估，我们识别出训练-测试分布的两个关键方面——组合等价性和模块覆盖率——它们对性能有显著影响。我们证明，直接模型（仅基于最终输出训练）的表观性能主要源于利用组合等价性，即不同模块序列最终简化为相同端到端函数的情况。当基准测试消除这些等价性时，性能会显著下降，表明它们无法泛化到已知模块的组合所产生的全新端到端函数。我们进一步证明，随着模块覆盖率偏移量增加（即模块在训练和测试中出现在不同上下文中），性能单调下降，这同时影响直接模型和逐步模型（基于中间和最终输出训练）。这些发现对基准测试设计具有实际意义：包含组合等价性的基准测试可能导致对直接模型泛化能力的显著高估，而同时包含模块覆盖率违规和组合等价性的基准测试会加剧捷径学习。作为案例研究，我们在编码基准测试LiveCodeBench的代码输出预测任务上，展示了组合等价性对预训练模型Llama3-8B泛化性能的作用。

articles.title: Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device
articles.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) running on mobile devices can keep user data private and work without connectivity. But they perform well only when fine-tuned for the target task and sized for the target device, a process that today requires repeated expert tuning. We present {\it Mobile AI Factory}, an agentic system that builds a fine-tuned, quantized SLM for a given task and phone. Given a task specification and a target phone, an orchestrator LLM chooses whether to tune hyperparameters, mine real data, or generate synthetic examples, while fixed rules roll back changes that hurt accuracy. The factory searches from small to large models across base models and quantizations, adapts its accuracy goal as it searches, and uses real measurements of the target phone across inference engines and backends. We evaluate Mobile AI Factory on ten tasks and four Android phones. On an unseen testset, its on-device models outperform two five-shot frontier models on five tasks, by up to 0.34, and match them on three more. Its search comes within 0.03 of exhaustively training all 27 model variants on an entity extraction task, while using 19$\times$ less GPU time. Phone measurements also matter: the best configuration changes across phones. Without phone measurements, Claude Opus 5.5, given the full hardware and model specifications, misses the app's requirements in 25\% of easy and moderate cases and in 60\% of hard ones. Code is available at: https://github.com/evanly-gh/SLM_Factory.
articles.titleCn: 移动AI工厂：为您的移动设备构建专用语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 在移动设备上运行的微型语言模型（SLMs）可以保护用户数据隐私，并在无连接状态下工作。但它们只有在针对目标任务进行微调和针对目标设备进行尺寸调整时才能表现良好，而这一过程目前需要反复的专家调校。我们提出了“移动AI工厂”，这是一个代理系统，用于为特定任务和手机构建微调和量化的SLM。给定任务规范和目标手机，协调大型语言模型（LLM）决定是否调整超参数、挖掘真实数据或生成合成示例，而固定的规则会回滚那些损害准确性的更改。该工厂从小的模型开始，逐步扩展到大的模型，在基础模型和量化方案中进行搜索，在搜索过程中调整其准确度目标，并使用目标手机在推理引擎和后端中的实际测量值。我们在十个任务和四部安卓手机上评估了移动AI工厂。在一个未见过的测试集上，其设备上的模型在五个任务上优于两个五次射击前沿模型，最高提升达0.34，并在另外三个任务上达到了同等水平。其搜索结果与穷尽训练所有27个模型变体在实体提取任务上的结果仅相差0.03，而使用的GPU时间却少了19倍。手机测量也很重要：最佳配置在不同手机上有所不同。没有手机测量值的情况下，即使给定完整的硬件和模型规格，Claude Opus 5.5在25%的简单和中等情况下以及60%的困难情况下未能满足应用要求。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/evanly-gh/SLM_Factory。

articles.title: Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry
articles.abstract: Accurate inertial odometry is critical for autonomous systems but suffers from unbounded drift caused by the integration of sensor noise and biases. In approaches such as TLIO, neural pseudo-measurements are trained independently of their downstream filter. This paper introduces Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry (DFIO), a learning framework that embeds the update stages of an error-state Kalman filter directly into a computational graph. Following standalone pre-training, DFIO jointly optimizes the displacement and covariance output heads using posterior-position supervision through differentiable measurement updates. The proposed system is validated on public pedestrian motion datasets featuring both calibrated and uncalibrated inertial measurements. Experimental results on a pedestrian dataset demonstrate that DFIO reduces mean absolute and one-second relative translation errors by 13.2% and 39.6% relative to the TLIO baseline, and by 7.7% and 17.4% relative to its pre-trained counterpart. Furthermore, evaluations on uncalibrated smartphone inertial data indicate that the proposed method effectively mitigates translational drift and maintains trajectory alignment under highly noisy sensor conditions. Source code will be made publicly available.
articles.titleCn: 惯性里程计的可微滤波
articles.abstractCn: 精确的惯性里程计对于自主系统至关重要，但其易受传感器噪声和偏差积分导致的不确定漂移影响。在TLIO等方法中，神经伪测量独立于其下游滤波器进行训练。本文介绍了惯性里程计的可微分滤波（DFIO），这是一个将误差状态卡尔曼滤波器的更新阶段直接嵌入计算图中的学习框架。在独立的预训练后，DFIO通过可微分的测量更新联合优化位移和协方差输出头，利用后置位置监督。所提出的系统在包含校准和非校准惯性测量的公共行人运动数据集上进行了验证。在行人数据集上的实验结果表明，与TLIO基线相比，DFIO将平均绝对值和一秒相对平移误差分别降低了13.2%和39.6%，与其预训练版本相比分别降低了7.7%和17.4%。此外，在非校准智能手机惯性数据上的评估表明，该方法有效减轻了平移漂移，并在高度噪声传感器条件下保持了轨迹对齐。源代码将公开提供。

articles.title: EJAI: Judgment-Preserving Civic AI for Data Center Environmental Justice
articles.abstract: Communities in the United States and around the world are contesting data centers, the physical infrastructure of AI. These disputes pose environmental justice issues: residents must weigh unevenly distributed burdens using evidence scattered across metrics, corporate claims, policy documents, and public testimony. A formative study with 10 users showed that dashboards and single-agent AI can settle questions before people examine that evidence. Here we present EJAI, a source-grounded system that links an interactive map, retrieved evidence, missing-data statements, and two stakeholder personas that allow people to inspect evidence and form their own policy recommendations. In a small functional benchmark of 21 queries, retrieved evidence supported 98.4% of factual claims and the system acknowledged missing evidence in 32 of 33 cases. Persona alignment carried a grounding cost: the Corporate Executive omitted some evidence that conflicted with its assigned priorities. In a within-subjects study, 15 participants acting as residents prepared for a simulated town hall. Some checked cited AI claims while treating map metrics as official, some made conditional recommendations with safeguards such as water-use disclosure, and some found the personas simplified or biased. Our results suggest that civic AI can support preparation for public reasoning when it makes evidence, gaps, and disagreement open to inspection, and that corpus imbalance and two-sided personas remain open justice concerns.
articles.titleCn: EJAI：用于数据中心环境正义的保留判断的公民AI
articles.abstractCn: 美国及全球的社区正在就数据中心——人工智能的物理基础设施——展开争议。这些争议引发了环境正义问题：居民必须权衡分布不均的负担，而这些证据散落在指标、企业声明、政策文件和公众证词之中。一项包含10名用户的形成性研究表明，仪表盘和单代理人工智能可以在人们审查证据之前解决这些问题。在此，我们提出了EJAI，一个基于来源的系统，它将交互式地图、检索到的证据、缺失数据声明以及两个利益相关者角色联系起来，使人们能够检查证据并形成自己的政策建议。在一个包含21个查询的小型功能性基准测试中，检索到的证据支持了98.4%的事实声明，系统在33个案例中的32个案例中承认了缺失的证据。角色一致性带来了一定的基础成本：企业高管遗漏了一些与其分配优先事项相冲突的证据。在一项被试内研究中，15名扮演居民的参与者为模拟市政厅会议做准备。有些人检查了引用的人工智能声明，同时将地图指标视为官方数据，有些人提出了带有如用水披露等安全措施的条件性建议，有些人则发现角色过于简化或存在偏见。我们的结果表明，当公民人工智能使证据、差距和分歧公开可查时，它可以支持公众推理的准备，而语料库不平衡和双向角色仍然是开放正义的关切。
